recipes.name: Visionary Acronym Framework
recipes.description: Constructing the high-level vision using a repetitive, rhythmic linguistic structure ('Global coverage, All spectra, Full applications, All senses, All digital, Strong security'). This mnemonic device makes the complex vision memorable and quotable.

recipes.name: Testbed Catalog
recipes.description: A dedicated, granular review of experimental facilities ('6G Testbeds'), categorizing them by purpose (Channels, Key Techs, Verification Platforms) and providing detailed specification tables (Frequency, Bandwidth, Org). This distinguishes a theoretical survey from a practical one.

recipes.name: Gap Analysis Matrix
recipes.description: A comparative table that maps previous surveys against specific content dimensions (Vision, KPIs, Architecture, Testbeds), using symbols to denote coverage depth. This visually proves the novelty and comprehensive nature of the current work.

recipes.name: KPI Explosion Framework
recipes.description: Dramatically expanding the set of Key Performance Indicators (from 5G's 8 to 6G's 17) to signal a paradigm shift. This includes categorizing them into functional groups (Data/Delay, Capacity/Coverage, efficiency, etc.).

recipes.name: Standardization Landscape Matrix
recipes.description: A strategic mapping of potential technologies to specific Standards Development Organizations (SDOs) like 3GPP, IEEE, ETSI, ITU-T/R. It clarifies the 'who is doing what' in the chaotic early phase of standardization.

recipes.name: Lessons Learned Stratification
recipes.description: A concluding 'Lessons Learned' section that distills the survey into high-level strategic imperatives (e.g., 'Scenario-based design', 'Reasonable planning'), moving beyond technical summary to advisor-like guidance.

title: Optical Wireless Communication in Atmosphere and Underwater: Statistical Models, Improvement Techniques, and Recent Applications

recipes.name: Meta-Survey Landscape Mapper
recipes.description: A table that inventories previous surveys and evaluates them against specific missing features to justify the current work.

recipes.name: Model Tractability Cataloging
recipes.description: Categorizing a large set of mathematical models not just by their physics, but by their 'Tractability' (ease of calculation) and 'Validity Regime'.

recipes.name: Synthesized 'Lessons Learned' Recap
recipes.description: Ending complex comparative sections with a dedicated 'Summary and Lessons Learned' subsection to consolidate insights.

recipes.name: Cross-Domain Trial Benchmarking
recipes.description: Grouping experimental trial results from different media (e.g., Atmosphere vs Underwater) into a single performance-tracking table.

recipes.name: Standardization and Tooling Roadmap
recipes.description: A practical section that aggregates non-academic resources like industry standards, simulation software, and open datasets to aid reproducibility.
